description: A gene represented by a DNA entity is physically part of a Reactome complex (PwGroup).

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources supporting the relationship; includes Reactome.

common_properties.name: version
common_properties.description: Reactome release number in which the relationship was last seen.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time when the relationship was created or last updated in SPOKE.

source_contributions.scope: Complexes associated with Signaling Pathways (R-HSA-162582), Immune System (R-HSA-168256), and Diseases of signal transduction by growth factor receptors and second messengers (R-HSA-5663202), including their descendant pathways. Complexes include those reachable through event participants, controllers, active units, nested components and set members.
source_contributions.description: Represents direct DNA components of complexes, with each compartment and modification variant of a complex kept distinct. Only DNA entities with an Ensembl gene ID matching an existing Gene are represented; RNA entities and non-complex sets are excluded. Alternative set members are never asserted to be physical components of the set. Stoichiometry is not represented.
